eventDetail.scope: For 84 years (held since 1942), MADI has been annually holding an international scientific-methodological and research conference “Intelligent technologies and electronic devices in vehicle and road transport complex”. During this period, the conference has become larger and more significant. MADI wants to allocate several sections and subsections to a higher level. These areas are: integrated automated control systems in the sectors of the transport and road complex; automation of production processes; organization and traffic safety.
